For Immediate Release:

March 25, 2026

Ocean Water Closure and Advisory - Avoid Water Contact and Wet Sand

The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health has issued an ocean water closure for the following area due to the release of approximately 300 gallons of sewage discharge on Avalon Beach.


· 50 yards upstream and downstream from the discharge point

Public Health officials are advising residents and visitors to avoid contact with ocean water and wet sand in the areas noted above. The release flowed to the nearby beach, affecting both the sand and ocean water.

The Department of Public Health will conduct water sampling, and the closure will remain in effect until Public Health receives two consecutive sampling results indicating that bacteria levels meet State standards.
